To cancel the order, I need to first find it in the system. Please provide one of the following:

1) The order ID (best option), or  
2) If you don’t have that, please share:
   - Email used on the order  
   - Shipping ZIP/postal code  
   - (Optional but helpful) Last 4 digits of the card you paid with

Also, do you want to:
- Cancel the entire order, or  
- Only cancel the coffee maker (if the order has other items)?

Once you share these, I’ll look up the order and walk you through the cancellation.
</action>
